record.question: Money Bill should be originated in the
options: Both in Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha
record.explanation: Answer A: Lok Sabha only. Article 109(1) prohibits introducing a Money Bill in the Council of States (Rajya Sabha), so it originates in the House of the People (Lok Sabha). Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/7af1daa22d65f9d04c00ae9b9aa5a799.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
